evidence: A model result of the offline storm-water chain on the design years (A28R_301k_design_l15_snow_s934, years 10-19), with stand-in storms (Walnut Gulch's measured family and CM1's 6 km window over wet ground), designed surfaces and designed pool floors; no climate feedback. Its numbers become final when the GCM and CM1 agree and the drylands' own storms replace the stand-ins.
reading_rule: wet_ppm_by_tenth (millionths, per cell in the order of cells): the mean share of each T21 cell's dryland area under standing water (1 cm or more at a pool's deepest point) in each tenth of the lunar day, from the tenth centred 162 degrees before noon to the one 162 after; wet_ppm_by_class: the day-mean wet share in pools of each persistence class (dry_within_the_storm_period, lasting_the_night, storm_period_to_the_next, standing); grid depressions and the crater bowls below the grid together. Variants are library__surface__age__seepage.
